open_work: Eleven original borrowed-light outlines remain. Fifty-five trim records, ten glass sheets and twenty-four adjoining wall records are refitted; the Photo sheet keeps its accepted six-millimetre native owner. Sill/head pockets subtract their former hidden overlap from the wall panels. Opening boundaries, retained end jambs and all source floor/top datums remain.

Ten thirty-millimetre glass boxes become six-millimetre sheets at their original centres. Split muntin/rebate stocks meet those faces without filling the glass volume. Existing registered public Glazing optics remain local overrides.
The retained masonry beyond the borrowed lights and unmodelled backs remain. This work establishes neither useful daylight transfer, a new route, weather capacity nor whole-shop acceptance.
Four accepted Photo portrait-rail fixing rods retain their original 2mm radius and 6mm wall embedment. This bounded mechanical fixing is explicitly checked; other penetrations still refuse.
